population.kidComparison: About 38.4 million people live in Morocco—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Morocco
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Morocco.

exploration.didYouKnow: Morocco is located in Northern Africa and its capital city is Rabat.
